purpose: Low-cost same-source causal-chain smoke test before a formal G1/RLVR run.

scoring.candidate_score: sum causal log probability of assistant response tokens including the common assistant terminator
scoring.candidate_policy: softmax over the seven candidate scores
scoring.target_metric: mean over target calibration rows of log P(candidate(z+q)) minus log P(gold candidate(z))

update.reward: 1 for gold and source-rule wrong candidate; 0 for the other five candidates
update.objective: exact expected reward under the normalized fixed-candidate policy

estimand.cell_effect: post target metric minus pre target metric
estimand.within_update_diagonal_excess: effect(r,r) minus mean over q != r of effect(r,q)
estimand.stack_summary: equal mean over the five source-rule diagonal excess values

claim_boundary: Not a formal run and not confirmatory evidence.
The eight-stack fixed-candidate screen is diagnostic development evidence, not a formal G1 result.
Fixed-candidate exact expected-reward optimization is an RLVR surrogate, not sampled RLVR.
Calibration-only readouts are development data and cannot be reported as hidden audit performance.
A pass only justifies the next frozen G1 and sampled-RLVR bridge experiments.
